title: When the Typewriter Turns
author: Kestrel Vasquez
blurb: Coral Amberdale, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
